train_gemma3_sft: train Gemma-3 12b on the Codeforces COTS dataset using SFTTrainer with deepspeed zero3
load_sft_dataset: load the open-r1/codeforces-cots dataset and remove the prompt column for SFT training
configure_sft_training: configure SFT training args with bf16, liger kernel, max length 8192, and gradient accumulation
train_multimodal_model: train a multimodal image-text-to-text model with SFTTrainer on a custom dataset
push_trained_model_hub: push a trained SFT model and dataset to the Hugging Face Hub
